'''Fyn Rhee''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] who danced in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] on the<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
[[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="db">{{DB|location|narshaddaa|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to make a living during the early reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fyn Rhee was first mentioned in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', written by [[Stephen J. Sansweet]] and [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
